layers.text: Recolour only the fur: the whole coat becomes a light honey cream, colour #e8d3a8, shaded warm fawn #b08e66, with a few lighter #f6ead0 tufts on the head and shoulders, so no fur is white, grey or blue. Keep the dark slate face, hands and feet, the ice club, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
